verses.en: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.pt: Inclina, Senhor, os teus ouvidos, e ouve-me, porque sou pobre e necessitado.
verses.en_web: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
verses.en_bbe: <A Prayer. Of David.> Let your ears be open to my voice, O Lord, and give me an answer; for I am poor and in need.

verses.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.pt: Preserva a minha vida, pois sou piedoso; o Deus meu, salva o teu servo, que em ti confia.
verses.en_web: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
verses.en_bbe: Keep my soul, for I am true to you; O my God, give salvation to your servant, whose hope is in you.

verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.pt: Compadece-te de mim, ó Senhor, pois a ti clamo o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
verses.en_bbe: Have mercy on me, O Lord; for my cry goes up to you all the day.

verses.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.pt: Alegra a alma do teu servo, pois a ti, Senhor, elevo a minha alma.
verses.en_web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Make glad the soul of your servant; for it is lifted up to you, O Lord.

verses.en: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.pt: Porque tu, Senhor, és bom, e pronto a perdoar, e abundante em benignidade para com todos os que te invocam.
verses.en_web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
verses.en_bbe: You are good, O Lord, and full of forgiveness; your mercy is great to all who make their cry to you.

verses.en: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.pt: Dá ouvidos, Senhor, à minha oração, e atende à voz das minhas súplicas.
verses.en_web: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, give ear to my prayer; and take note of the sound of my requests.

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.pt: No dia da minha angústia clamo a ti, porque tu me respondes.
verses.en_web: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
verses.en_bbe: In the day of my trouble I send up my cry to you; for you will give me an answer.

verses.en: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.pt: Entre os deuses nenhum há semelhante a ti, Senhor, nem há obras como as tuas.
verses.en_web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
verses.en_bbe: There is no god like you, O Lord; there are no works like your works.

verses.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.pt: Todas as nações que fizeste virão e se prostrarão diante de ti, Senhor, e glorificarão o teu nome.
verses.en_web: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
verses.en_bbe: Let all the nations whom you have made come and give worship to you, O Lord, giving glory to your name.

verses.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
verses.pt: Ensina-me, Senhor, o teu caminho, e andarei na tua verdade; dispõe o meu coração para temer o teu nome.
verses.en_web: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
verses.en_bbe: For you are great, and do great works of wonder; you only are God.

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.pt: Louvar-te-ei, Senhor Deus meu, de todo o meu coração, e glorificarei o teu nome para sempre.
verses.en_web: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
verses.en_bbe: Make your way clear to me, O Lord; I will go on my way in your faith: let my heart be glad in the fear of your name.

verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.pt: Pois grande é a tua benignidade para comigo, e livraste a minha alma das profundezas do Seol.
verses.en_web: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will give glory to your name for ever.

verses.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.pt: Pois grande é a tua benignidade para comigo, e livraste a minha alma das profundezas do Seol.
verses.en_web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: For your mercy to me is great; you have taken my soul up from the deep places of the underworld.

verses.en: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, os soberbos têm-se levantado contra mim, e um bando de homens violentos procura tirar-me a vida; eles não te puseram diante dos seus olhos.
verses.en_web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
verses.en_bbe: O God, men of pride have come up against me, and the army of violent men would take my life; they have not put you before them.

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.pt: Mas tu, Senhor, és um Deus compassivo e benigno, longânimo, e abundante em graça e em fidelidade.
verses.en_web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
verses.en_bbe: But you, O Lord, are a God full of pity and forgiveness, slow to get angry, great in mercy and wisdom.

verses.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.pt: Volta-te para mim, e compadece-te de mim; dá a tua força ao teu servo, e a salva o filho da tua serva.
verses.en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
verses.en_bbe: O be turned to me and have mercy on me: give your strength to your servant, and your salvation to the son of her who is your servant.

verses.en: Show me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
verses.pt: Mostra-me um sinal do teu favor, para que o vejam aqueles que me odeiam, e sejam envergonhados, por me haveres tu, Senhor, ajuntado e confortado.
verses.en_web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
verses.en_bbe: Give me a sign for good; so that my haters may see it and be shamed; because you, Lord, have been my help and comfort.
